sourceCoverageGaps.description: The retained 22-page PDF visually clips several crop names in the sample crop/value tables. ICF-13 does not reconstruct clipped identities. Existing ICF-03/06 governed MHT source assertions for Wheat, Fire Blossom and Etherleaf remain authoritative source mappings.

The PDF says to see a full crop Appendix, but no such appendix is present in the retained 22 pages. ICF-03/04/06 libraries provide canonical ingredient breadth; ICF-13 does not invent the missing source appendix.
